parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.7) between `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesPauseEvent` (line 293) and `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesStopEvent` (line 310) reflects the intentional parallel structure of distinct event-capture test cases — each test must independently assert a specific analytics event (pause vs. stop) and collapsing them would obscure test intent and make failure diagnosis harder. No production code is involved, so no shared-code coupling risk exists.
